reviews.text: Terrible service. I asked them to cut my pet's hair in a specific way, but they did a poor job; furthermore, the cut wasn't even—they left some patches of hair long while others were short. I am completely dissatisfied with their service.

This was my first time getting my dog groomed, and I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The prices were extremely reasonable, and the staff were so kind, welcoming, and accommodating from the moment I walked in.

My dog is very sweet, but he absolutely hates having his paws touched (he’s a corgi) even the vet won’t do it. I honestly told them not to worry about trying to clip his nails, so I was shocked when they were able to get all of them done!

Not to mention they must have been incredibly patient and gentle with him. I was fully expecting him to be extremely anxious and nervous when I picked him up (he can get a little weird in new places), but he was actually so happy and relaxed. That really showed me how well they treated him and how much care they gave him throughout the process.

On top of that, his haircut looks amazing and I know how squirmy he can be, so that’s no small feat!

I’m beyond impressed and will definitely be returning. Thank you so much for taking such great care of my baby!

The absolute best! I’ve trusted them with my dogs for years. They are professional, kind, & compassionate. They recently helped with an emergency rescue groom. If you want groomers who truly care - you found them!

Katy and tam are amazing with my two pups. I have been going to them for 15 years now. They started with my rottie and when I got my yorkie I took her there. Now I take my yorkie and Great Dane to them.

They take pride in what they do. Always making sure the pups are good. They treat my dogs as their own. They are personable.

Grooming is top tier! My dogs come back feeling brand new. Their nails are always clipped and eyes are always clean and smelling great from their bath. My yorkies haircut always looks amazing.

I wouldn’t go anywhere else. I would always take my dogs to tam and Kate as long as they are in business. They are family to us now and my dogs wouldn’t know anyone else. They are the best of the best.

Thanks for always taking care of my dogs. You guys are amazing

I’m extremely disappointed with Canine Clippers in Manayunk.

My dog has been going here regularly for almost a year, so I trusted his grooming was being handled properly. After missing one appointment, we bathed him at home and noticed he was sensitive about one paw. When we looked closer, we found his dewclaw had grown so long it had curled into and was embedded in his paw pad.

This does not happen in a few weeks. It was clearly missed over multiple visits.

We had to cut it out ourselves just to relieve his pain, and even then it was still overgrown and sore. My dog is a rescue who came to us with neglected nail growth, so keeping his nails properly maintained is especially important to us.

The fact that he ended up back in pain from something so basic and preventable shows a serious lack of care and attention.

I would not trust them with my dog again.

===========
4/1 Edit: The owner suggested this could be due to a long quick. That is not the case. My dog has white claws, and I was able to safely trim AND grind the nail multiple times without getting near the quick. I checked all four dewclaws and they showed the same level of overgrowth well beyond what a “long quick” would explain.

I had my usual groomer cancel the day of my appointment, and Canine Clippers had me in the next day! My pup has been shiny, she still smells good, and she barely sheds! All after almost 2 full weeks! Safe to say THIS is my go-to groomer now :)
This place  pulled my dog down the steps and when they were done my dog was scared don’t Trust place. Animal abuses
My dog won’t let me do his nails or a bath! When I take him there he get excited and when they’re done with him he looked so beautiful!! Thank you!

My dog went to CC a few years ago and had a fine experience. He's a short haired dog, so I don't need to get him groomed often but we forgot to make a nail clipping appointment and our vet couldn't get us in before we left our dog with family while on a trip. I called and asked for a nail trim and she said she'd only do a full groom, but she could get us in before we left so I said OK. I explained on the phone that my dog was large (110lbs) and she said it wasn't a problem. My husband took him in and came back 2 hours later as they requested and they informed him that he was too large and they couldn't do anything for him. Not only did I tell her how large he was, she also saw him and could have sent him home with my husband when he dropped him off. She said she only managed a half shampoo and his nails still weren't trimmed.

This was our second time there. First time was great, I walked in and my dog was hanging on the bench while the groomer was at the desk. Happy as a clam.

This week, I walked in, the groomer asked what dog was mine, she went in the back, of course my dog was excited to leave, and the groomer started screaming at my dog. Telling her there was something wrong with her. My dog is a 50 pound, 6 year old, professionally trained dog… does she get excited, yes. But was she a ferocious beast that needed to be controlled? No.

If this is how comfortable the groomer is talking to dogs in front of their owners, I truly can’t imagine what she’s saying and doing to these dogs when the owners aren’t there.

We are not crazy dog people that expect a red carpet rolled out for a dog. But, we’re legitimately concerned that she abused our dog. She has not been the same since we brought her home. She won’t leave our side and if she can’t see us, starts whimpering. I feel so awful. I’ve never heard someone speak to animals like this.

The groomer did get us in quick and the cut is good. But, I will never recommend this place ever again after hearing how she screamed at our dog while I was standing right there. There’s no way she doesn’t use physical force when people aren’t there.
They gave my 4 month old a nice close cut. She gets hot in the summer easily. Though, it took me adjusting because I love her floof, I love the cut! They were great with my girl. Thank you!
I have 2 large breed dogs, one with a double coat! And one with arthritis! They were so great with them, and both pups came back relaxed and smelling great! They were attentive to their needs!
Wonderful experience, they are very patient  with my cat.

I could not be happier with my experience bringing my dog Bernie here for grooming.

Tammy is exceptionally pleasant and skilled at what she does. My dog is a rescue with a traumatic background and she had him so at ease when I came in to pick him up, that lets me know that she treated him with the patience and care he needs.

Haircut looks great too, we will definitely be coming back!
